node.statement: Lemma 3.4 (Partial trace of purification channel): tr_{Y'P'Q'}(Phi^{d,r}(rho|_lambda)) = rho|_lambda. That is, tracing out the ancillary registers introduced by the purification channel recovers the original post-Schur-sampling state. Proof: From the explicit formula of Phi on Schur-basis states, the partial trace over Y',P',Q' collapses the EPR state and maximally mixed ancilla, leaving rho|_lambda intact.
